purpose: Label-free offline feature preprocessing for the 3,010 recordings of the SLURP test SAMPLE (roster SLURP-TEST-SAMPLE-3010-V1, docs/receipts/rosters/slurp-test-sample-3010-v1.json; runtime view configs/dataset/slurp-speech-native-test-sample-3010.json, the label-free restriction of configs/dataset/slurp-speech-native-test-full.json to the sample's ids). Preparation 1 of 3 of the sample, permitted by the signed allowance docs/receipts/owner/2026-09-27-slurp-test-sample-allowance-v1.json (owner decision 151) and allowed to run ahead of the dev-admitted composed arm by owner decision 156 of 2026-09-27; plan docs/readiness/2026-09-27-slurp-test-sample-preparations-v1.md. The sample's rows are rows of the FULL test split, none of which has ever been encoded here (the 2026-09-23 FULL measurement found 0 of 13,078 warm and 0 promoted), so this run contacts every sample row exactly once at max_tokens 1 through a CPU-only llama-server sidecar on port 8081 and never re-touches an existing packet. Keep the resident decoder-only inference service on port 8080 untouched. The legacy feature-cache key is the FNV-1a hash of the media bytes ALONE, so the prompt cannot affect the cached features; the fixed one-token response is never read semantically; and no sentence, transcript, scenario, action, intent, entity, gold or score of the test split is opened by this pass. Every mode of scripts/slurp_evo_fold_preprocess.py re-verifies the pinned allowance bytes before the data root is opened. Precedent: SAEA-SN-TEST-FULL-PREPROCESS (2026-09-23, configs/experiment/slurp-test-full-preprocess.json), whose fragment this one copies with the roster, allowance, run id and counts swapped.
